people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
translations.bsb: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
